#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headline paragraphs in the unpacked quarterly_report docx.

Headlines are identified as non-empty paragraphs whose alphabetic characters are
all uppercase (the report's section titles); body text, bullets, and table rows
are mixed case and are left untouched. Underline is applied as run-level
<w:u w:val="single"/> in every run of each headline paragraph.
"""
import os
import re
import sys

W_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
WORK = os.path.join(BASE, "quarterly_report_work")
if not os.path.isdir(WORK):
    WORK = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "quarterly_report_work")
if len(sys.argv) > 1:
    WORK = sys.argv[1]

DOCXML = os.path.join(WORK, "word", "document.xml")

PRECEDE_U = {
    "rFonts", "b", "bCs", "i", "iCs", "caps", "smallCaps", "strike",
    "dstrike", "outline", "shadow", "emboss", "imprint", "noProof",
    "snapToGrid", "vanish", "webHidden", "color", "spacing", "w", "kern",
    "position", "sz", "szCs", "highlight",
}


def local_name(tag_or_node):
    return tag_or_node.rsplit(":", 1)[-1]


def is_headline(text):
    t = (text or "").strip()
    if not t:
        return False
    letters = [c for c in t if c.isalpha()]
    return bool(letters) and all(c.isupper() for c in letters)


def run_via_document_library(headlines):
    """Preferred path: skill Document library (defusedxml minidom DOM)."""
    skill_root = None
    candidates = [os.path.join(BASE, ".codex", "skills", "docx"),
                  os.path.join(os.getcwd(), ".codex", "skills", "docx"),
                  os.path.join(os.path.dirname(BASE), ".codex", "skills", "docx")]
    for cand in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(cand, "scripts", "document.py")):
            skill_root = cand
            break
    if skill_root is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Document library not found")

    sys.path.insert(0, skill_root)
    from scripts.document import Document  # noqa: E402

    doc = Document(WORK)
    ed = doc["word/document.xml"]
    dom = ed.dom
    changed = 0
    for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
        text = "".join(
            (t.firstChild.data if t.firstChild is not None else "")
            for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t")
        )
        if not is_headline(text):
            continue
        headlines.append(text.strip())
        for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
            rpr_list = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
            if rpr_list:
                rpr = rpr_list[0]
            else:
                rpr = dom.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:rPr")
                r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
            if rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
                continue
            u = dom.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            anchor = None
            for child in rpr.childNodes:
                if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE:
                    if local_name(child.tagName) in PRECEDE_U:
                        anchor = child
            if anchor is not None:
                rpr.insertBefore(u, anchor.nextSibling)
            else:
                rpr.appendChild(u)
            changed += 1
    doc.save()
    return changed


def run_et_fallback(headlines):
    """Fallback: stdlib ElementTree edit of the unpacked document.xml."""
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

    for prefix, uri in (
        ("ve", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"),
        ("o", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office"),
        ("r", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"),
        ("v", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml"),
        ("wp", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing"),
        ("w10", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word"),
        ("w", W_NS),
    ):
        ET.register_namespace(prefix, uri)

    tree = ET.parse(DOCXML)
    root = tree.getroot()
    changed = 0
    for p in root.iter(W_NS + "p"):
        text = "".join(
            (t.text or "") for t in p.iter(W_NS + "t")
        )
        if not is_headline(text):
            continue
        headlines.append(text.strip())
        for r in p.findall(W_NS + "r"):
            rpr = r.find(W_NS + "rPr")
            if rpr is None:
                rpr = ET.Element(W_NS + "rPr")
                r.insert(0, rpr)
            if rpr.find(W_NS + "u") is not None:
                continue
            u = ET.Element(W_NS + "u")
            u.set(W_NS + "val", "single")
            idx = 0
            for i, child in enumerate(rpr):
                if local_name(child.tag) in PRECEDE_U:
                    idx = i + 1
            rpr.insert(idx, u)
            changed += 1

    # Serialize, then write in ASCII to mirror the source file's encoding,
    # mapping any non-ASCII characters to numeric character references.
    body = ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    ascii_body = re.sub(r"[^\x00-\x7F]", lambda m: "&#%d;" % ord(m.group(0)), body)
    if not ascii_body.endswith("\n"):
        ascii_body += "\n"
    with open(DOCXML, "w", encoding="ascii", newline="") as fh:
        fh.write('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ascii"?>\n')
        fh.write(ascii_body)
    return changed


def main():
    if not os.path.isfile(DOCXML):
        print("ERROR: cannot find %s" % DOCXML)
        return 2

    headlines = []
    try:
        changed = run_via_document_library(headlines)
        method = "Document library"
    except Exception as exc:  # fall back to stdlib editing
        headlines = []
        try:
            changed = run_et_fallback(headlines)
            method = "ElementTree fallback (%s)" % exc
        except Exception as exc2:
            print("ERROR: both edit paths failed: %s" % exc2)
            return 1

    print("method=%s" % method)
    print("headlines_underlined=%d" % len(headlines))
    for h in headlines:
        print("HEADLINE: %s" % h)
    print("runs_updated=%d" % changed)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headlines in unpacked_quarterly/word/document.xml.

Headlines in this report are paragraphs whose visible text is entirely
uppercase (all-caps title lines, e.g. "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
"FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS", "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT"). Body prose,
bullets, table rows, and separators contain lowercase letters or no
alphabetical characters and are left untouched.
"""
import os
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
ET.register_namespace("w", W)
WP = "{" + W + "}"

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DOC_PATH = os.path.join(BASE, "unpacked_quarterly", "word", "document.xml")


def local_name(el):
    tag = el.tag
    return tag[tag.rfind("}") + 1:] if tag.startswith("{") else tag


def para_text(p):
    return "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter(WP + "t"))


def is_headline(p):
    txt = para_text(p).strip()
    if not txt:
        return False
    if not re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", txt):
        return False
    # Headline lines contain no lowercase letters (all-caps titles).
    return not re.search(r"[a-z]", txt)


# Schema order for CT_RPr children around w:u.
ORDER = [
    "rStyle", "rFonts", "b", "bCs", "i", "iCs", "caps", "smallCaps",
    "strike", "dstrike", "outline", "shadow", "emboss", "imprint",
    "noProof", "snapToGrid", "vanish", "webHidden", "color", "spacing",
    "w", "kern", "position", "sz", "szCs", "highlight", "u", "effect",
    "bdr", "shd", "fitText", "vertAlign", "rtl", "cs", "em", "lang",
    "eastAsianLayout", "specVanish", "oMath",
]
BEFORE_U = set(ORDER[:ORDER.index("u")])
AFTER_U = set(ORDER[ORDER.index("u") + 1:])


def ensure_underline(run):
    rpr = run.find(WP + "rPr")
    if rpr is None:
        rpr = ET.Element(WP + "rPr")
        run.insert(0, rpr)
    u = rpr.find(WP + "u")
    if u is None:
        u = ET.Element(WP + "u")
        children = list(rpr)
        before_idx = -1
        after_idx = len(children)
        for i, ch in enumerate(children):
            name = local_name(ch)
            if name in BEFORE_U:
                before_idx = i
            elif name in AFTER_U and after_idx == len(children):
                after_idx = i
        if before_idx >= 0:
            rpr.insert(before_idx + 1, u)
        elif after_idx < len(children):
            rpr.insert(after_idx, u)
        else:
            rpr.append(u)
    u.set(WP + "val", "single")


def main():
    tree = ET.parse(DOC_PATH)
    root = tree.getroot()

    headlines = []
    for p in root.iter(WP + "p"):
        if not is_headline(p):
            continue
        text = para_text(p).strip()
        runs = list(p.iter(WP + "r"))
        for run in runs:
            ensure_underline(run)
        headlines.append(text)

    tree.write(DOC_PATH, xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8")

    # Verify: re-parse and confirm every headline run is underlined.
    tree2 = ET.parse(DOC_PATH)
    underlined = 0
    for p in tree2.getroot().iter(WP + "p"):
        if not is_headline(p):
            continue
        for run in p.iter(WP + "r"):
            rpr = run.find(WP + "rPr")
            u = None if rpr is None else rpr.find(WP + "u")
            if u is not None and u.get(WP + "val") == "single":
                underlined += 1

    print("Headlines underlined: %d" % len(headlines))
    for h in headlines:
        print("  - %s" % h)
    print("Underlined headline runs after verification: %d" % underlined)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headlines in unpacked_quarterly/word/document.xml.

Headlines in this report are paragraphs whose visible text is entirely
uppercase (all-caps title lines, e.g. "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
"FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS", "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT"). Body prose,
bullets, table rows, and separators contain lowercase letters or no
alphabetical characters and are left untouched.

Each headline run's <w:rPr> gets exactly one <w:u w:val="single"/>
placed at the correct schema position (after sz/szCs/sz-cs/highlight,
before effect/bdr/...). Any pre-existing underline elements are removed
first so re-runs stay idempotent and never duplicate.
"""
import os
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
ET.register_namespace("w", W)
WP = "{" + W + "}"

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DOC_PATH = os.path.join(BASE, "unpacked_quarterly", "word", "document.xml")


def local_name(el):
    tag = el.tag
    return tag[tag.rfind("}") + 1:] if tag.startswith("{") else tag


def para_text(p):
    return "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter(WP + "t"))


def is_headline(p):
    txt = para_text(p).strip()
    if not txt:
        return False
    if not re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", txt):
        return False
    # Headline lines contain no lowercase letters (all-caps titles).
    return not re.search(r"[a-z]", txt)


# rPr children allowed before w:u (schema order; both camelCase and
# hyphenated spellings such as szCs/sz-cs are handled).
PRECEDE_U = {
    "rStyle", "rFonts", "b", "bCs", "b-cs", "i", "iCs", "i-cs",
    "caps", "smallCaps", "strike", "dstrike", "outline", "shadow",
    "emboss", "imprint", "noProof", "snapToGrid", "vanish",
    "webHidden", "color", "spacing", "w", "kern", "position", "sz",
    "szCs", "sz-cs", "highlight",
}
FOLLOW_U = {
    "effect", "bdr", "shd", "fitText", "vertAlign", "rtl", "cs",
    "em", "lang", "eastAsianLayout", "specVanish", "oMath",
}


def ensure_underline(run):
    rpr = run.find(WP + "rPr")
    if rpr is None:
        rpr = ET.Element(WP + "rPr")
        run.insert(0, rpr)
    # Deduplicate and clear existing underline elements first.
    for existing in rpr.findall(WP + "u"):
        rpr.remove(existing)

    u = ET.Element(WP + "u")
    u.set(WP + "val", "single")
    children = list(rpr)
    before_idx = -1
    after_idx = len(children)
    for i, ch in enumerate(children):
        name = local_name(ch)
        if name in PRECEDE_U:
            before_idx = i
        elif name in FOLLOW_U and after_idx == len(children):
            after_idx = i
    if before_idx >= 0:
        rpr.insert(before_idx + 1, u)
    elif after_idx < len(children):
        rpr.insert(after_idx, u)
    else:
        rpr.append(u)


def main():
    tree = ET.parse(DOC_PATH)
    root = tree.getroot()

    headlines = []
    for p in root.iter(WP + "p"):
        if not is_headline(p):
            continue
        text = para_text(p).strip()
        for run in p.iter(WP + "r"):
            ensure_underline(run)
        headlines.append(text)

    tree.write(DOC_PATH, xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8")

    # Verify after re-parse: exactly one underline run property per
    # headline run, val="single", correctly ordered within <w:rPr>.
    tree2 = ET.parse(DOC_PATH)
    underlined_runs = 0
    u_elements = 0
    problems = 0
    for p in tree2.getroot().iter(WP + "p"):
        if not is_headline(p):
            continue
        for run in p.iter(WP + "r"):
            rpr = run.find(WP + "rPr")
            us = [] if rpr is None else rpr.findall(WP + "u")
            if not us:
                problems += 1
                continue
            u_elements += len(us)
            if len(us) != 1 or us[0].get(WP + "val") != "single":
                problems += 1
                continue
            underlined_runs += 1
            siblings = list(rpr)
            ui = siblings.index(us[0])
            for j, ch in enumerate(siblings):
                if ch is us[0]:
                    continue
                name = local_name(ch)
                if j < ui and name in FOLLOW_U:
                    problems += 1

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headline paragraphs in the unpacked quarterly_report docx.

Headlines are identified as non-empty paragraphs whose alphabetic characters are
all uppercase (the report's section titles); body text, bullets, and table rows
are mixed case and are left untouched. Underline is applied as run-level
<w:u w:val="single"/> in every run of each headline paragraph.
"""
import os
import re
import sys

W_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
WORK = os.path.join(BASE, "quarterly_report_work")
if not os.path.isdir(WORK):
    WORK = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "quarterly_report_work")
if len(sys.argv) > 1:
    WORK = sys.argv[1]

DOCXML = os.path.join(WORK, "word", "document.xml")

PRECEDE_U = {
    "rFonts", "b", "bCs", "i", "iCs", "caps", "smallCaps", "strike",
    "dstrike", "outline", "shadow", "emboss", "imprint", "noProof",
    "snapToGrid", "vanish", "webHidden", "color", "spacing", "w", "kern",
    "position", "sz", "szCs", "highlight",
}


def local_name(tag_or_node):
    return tag_or_node.rsplit(":", 1)[-1]


def is_headline(text):
    t = (text or "").strip()
    if not t:
        return False
    letters = [c for c in t if c.isalpha()]
    return bool(letters) and all(c.isupper() for c in letters)


def run_via_document_library(headlines):
    """Preferred path: skill Document library (defusedxml minidom DOM)."""
    skill_root = None
    candidates = [os.path.join(BASE, ".codex", "skills", "docx"),
                  os.path.join(os.getcwd(), ".codex", "skills", "docx"),
                  os.path.join(os.path.dirname(BASE), ".codex", "skills", "docx")]
    for cand in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(cand, "scripts", "document.py")):
            skill_root = cand
            break
    if skill_root is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Document library not found")

    sys.path.insert(0, skill_root)
    from scripts.document import Document  # noqa: E402

    doc = Document(WORK)
    ed = doc["word/document.xml"]
    dom = ed.dom
    changed = 0
    for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
        text = "".join(
            (t.firstChild.data if t.firstChild is not None else "")
            for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t")
        )
        if not is_headline(text):
            continue
        headlines.append(text.strip())
        for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
            rpr_list = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
            if rpr_list:
                rpr = rpr_list[0]
            else:
                rpr = dom.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:rPr")
                r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
            if rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
                continue
            u = dom.createElementNS(W_NS, "w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            anchor = None
            for child in rpr.childNodes:
                if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE:
                    if local_name(child.tagName) in PRECEDE_U:
                        anchor = child
            if anchor is not None:
                rpr.insertBefore(u, anchor.nextSibling)
            else:
                rpr.appendChild(u)
            changed += 1
    doc.save()
    return changed


def run_et_fallback(headlines):
    """Fallback: stdlib ElementTree edit of the unpacked document.xml."""
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

    for prefix, uri in (
        ("ve", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"),
        ("o", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office"),
        ("r", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"),
        ("v", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml"),
        ("wp", "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing"),
        ("w10", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word"),
        ("w", W_NS),
    ):
        ET.register_namespace(prefix, uri)

    tree = ET.parse(DOCXML)
    root = tree.getroot()
    changed = 0
    for p in root.iter(W_NS + "p"):
        text = "".join(
            (t.text or "") for t in p.iter(W_NS + "t")
        )
        if not is_headline(text):
            continue
        headlines.append(text.strip())
        for r in p.findall(W_NS + "r"):
            rpr = r.find(W_NS + "rPr")
            if rpr is None:
                rpr = ET.Element(W_NS + "rPr")
                r.insert(0, rpr)
            if rpr.find(W_NS + "u") is not None:
                continue
            u = ET.Element(W_NS + "u")
            u.set(W_NS + "val", "single")
            idx = 0
            for i, child in enumerate(rpr):
                if local_name(child.tag) in PRECEDE_U:
                    idx = i + 1
            rpr.insert(idx, u)
            changed += 1

    # Serialize, then write in ASCII to mirror the source file's encoding,
    # mapping any non-ASCII characters to numeric character references.
    body = ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    ascii_body = re.sub(r"[^\x00-\x7F]", lambda m: "&#%d;" % ord(m.group(0)), body)
    if not ascii_body.endswith("\n"):
        ascii_body += "\n"
    with open(DOCXML, "w", encoding="ascii", newline="") as fh:
        fh.write('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ascii"?>\n')
        fh.write(ascii_body)
    return changed


def main():
    if not os.path.isfile(DOCXML):
        print("ERROR: cannot find %s" % DOCXML)
        return 2

    headlines = []
    try:
        changed = run_via_document_library(headlines)
        method = "Document library"
    except Exception as exc:  # fall back to stdlib editing
        headlines = []
        try:
            changed = run_et_fallback(headlines)
            method = "ElementTree fallback (%s)" % exc
        except Exception as exc2:
            print("ERROR: both edit paths failed: %s" % exc2)
            return 1

    print("method=%s" % method)
    print("headlines_underlined=%d" % len(headlines))
    for h in headlines:
        print("HEADLINE: %s" % h)
    print("runs_updated=%d" % changed)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

    txt = para_text(p).strip()
    if not txt:
        return False
    if not re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", txt):

    # Headline lines contain no lowercase letters (all-caps titles).
    return not re.search(r"[a-z]", txt)


# Schema order for CT_RPr children around w:u.

    "rStyle", "rFonts", "b", "bCs", "i", "iCs", "caps", "smallCaps",
    "strike", "dstrike", "outline", "shadow", "emboss", "imprint",
    "noProof", "snapToGrid", "vanish", "webHidden", "color", "spacing",

    "bdr", "shd", "fitText", "vertAlign", "rtl", "cs", "em", "lang",
    "eastAsianLayout", "specVanish", "oMath",
]
BEFORE_U = set(ORDER[:ORDER.index("u")])
AFTER_U = set(ORDER[ORDER.index("u") + 1:])


def ensure_underline(run):
    rpr = run.find(WP + "rPr")

        rpr = ET.Element(WP + "rPr")

        u = ET.Element(WP + "u")

                before_idx = i
            elif name in AFTER_U and after_idx == len(children):
                after_idx = i
        if before_idx >= 0:
            rpr.insert(before_idx + 1, u)
        elif after_idx < len(children):
            rpr.insert(after_idx, u)
        else:
            rpr.append(u)

def main():
    tree = ET.parse(DOC_PATH)
    root = tree.getroot()

    headlines = []
    for p in root.iter(WP + "p"):
        if not is_headline(p):

    # Verify: re-parse and confirm every headline run is underlined.

if __name__ == "__main__":

    return not re.search(r"[a-z]", txt)

    "rStyle", "rFonts", "b", "bCs", "b-cs", "i", "iCs", "i-cs",
    "caps", "smallCaps", "strike", "dstrike", "outline", "shadow",
    "emboss", "imprint", "noProof", "snapToGrid", "vanish",
    "webHidden", "color", "spacing", "w", "kern", "position", "sz",
    "szCs", "sz-cs", "highlight",
}

    "effect", "bdr", "shd", "fitText", "vertAlign", "rtl", "cs",
    "em", "lang", "eastAsianLayout", "specVanish", "oMath",
}
